name: Keep Has Labs
remarks: Keep module for the Synthea -k flag. NOT a regular module — do not load it via -d.
Exports only patients who have all four HAPI metabolic/CBC lab observations recorded:
Uses the Observation logic condition with operator 'is not nil', which checks
person.record.getLatestObservation(code) rather than an active/ongoing Condition.
Second step of an incremental keep module (see keep_has_albumin.json for the first step):
requires all four lab values instead of just albumin.
Set --exporter.years_of_history >= (max_age - min_age) when using this module — Observation
entries have no 'still active' export exemption, so a short history window can silently drop
the qualifying lab even though the keep check passed. See synthea-module-author.md.
All four LOINC codes validated against tx.fhir.org on 2026-09-04.
